atoms.b: Why can you see through some objects and not see through others?

Different objects allow different amounts of ((++light light_sources)) to pass through them. Objects that let all light through are ((++transparent opaque)). Objects that don’t let any light through are ((++opaque transparent)).
Is it possible for an object to only let some light through?
atoms.sound: Is it possible for an object to only let sum light through?

atoms.b: Yes, objects that only let some light through are ((++translucent transparent opaque)).
atoms.sound: Yes, objects that only let sum light through are translucent.
